services.desc: Galveston fishing trips are a specialized private guided charter in the surrounding bay complex, which the Captain will determine where the trip will take place. The main bodies of water include Galveston Bay, Trinity Bay, East Bay, West Bay, the Galveston Channel and the surrounding bay waters. Known to inhabit the Galveston Bay Area are speckled trout, red fish, flounder, sand trout, gulf trout, golden croakers, gulf whiting, black drum, and a variety of sharks . No matter what time of the year it is even winter, most of these fish are very abundant in most parts of the Galveston Bay Complex.
